mentions.name: Leaddly
mentions.description: All-in-one platform for web developers to find and manage clients. It finds local businesses with no websites (or audits bad ones with built-in SEO tools), and lets users build contracts, create billable invoices, and track tasks for clients in a lightweight, web-dev-focused CRM.
mentions.problem: Web developers need a single tool to find local businesses without websites as leads and manage client work (contracts, invoicing, tasks) in one place.
mentions.audience: Web developers looking to find and manage clients
mentions.source_excerpt:
Find local businesses with no websites (or check bad ones with built in SEO tools).

Build contracts, create billable invoices and track tasks for clients with a lightweight, web dev focused CRM.

Essentially, an all in one platform for web developers to find and manage their clients
